description: A PHP trait providing helper methods for managing entities with Doctrine ORM, including repository access, persistence, removal, query building, pagination, and transaction control.

methods.name: getRepository
methods.description: Returns the repository for a given entity class.

methods.name: persist
methods.description: Persists an entity and flushes changes to the database.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Removes an entity and flushes changes to the database.

methods.name: createQueryBuilder
methods.description: Creates a new QueryBuilder for a specified entity with an alias.

methods.name: getPaginator
methods.description: Wraps a QueryBuilder in a Paginator object.

methods.name: getQueryBuilderWrapper
methods.description: Wraps a QueryBuilder in a QueryBuilderWrapper object.

methods.name: fetchOne
methods.description: Fetches a single entity result from a QueryBuilder with an optional offset.

methods.name: getReference
methods.description: Gets a reference to an entity by class name and ID.

methods.name: rollBackTransaction
methods.description: Rolls back the current database transaction.
